hooks.command: echo 'Reminder: call the get_guidelines MCP tool once this session before any UI5 work. See CLAUDE.md for the agent roster and /sap-plan, /sap-ship, /sap-retro pipelines.'

python3 -c "
import json,re,sys
data=json.load(sys.stdin)
cmd=data.get('tool_input',{}).get('command','')
patterns=[r'rm\s+-rf', r'cf\s+delete', r'cf\s+unbind', r'DROP\s+TABLE', r'DROP\s+SCHEMA', r'git\s+push\s+--force', r'--delete']
for p in patterns:
    if re.search(p, cmd, re.IGNORECASE):
        print(f'[guard] Command matches destructive pattern \"{p}\": double-check this is intended before proceeding.', file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(0)
"
